orders.title: Echoes of the Deep
orders.description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler set in an underwater city. Players customize their submarine and explore procedurally generated depths filled with mysteries and sea creatures.

orders.title: Petal Quest
orders.description: A cozy life simulation game where players cultivate magical plants and befriend woodland creatures to restore a once-thriving enchanted garden.

orders.title: EcoShopper Dashboard
orders.description: A sleek and intuitive dashboard for an eco-conscious shopping platform, focusing on carbon footprint tracking and personalized recommendations.
